mapper.update: CREATE TABLE ${tableName} ( SEQ integer, AGENT_ID character varying(50), WATCHDOG_STATUS character varying(10), WATCHDOG_INTERVAL integer, THREAD_LLT character varying(1000), UPDATE_DATE timestamp, ETC character varying(256) )
CREATE SEQUENCE ${tableName}_SEQ START WITH 1 MAXVALUE 99999999 MINVALUE 1 CYCLE CACHE 20
mapper.select: SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS update_date, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} WHERE WATCHDOG_STATUS = #{watchdogStatus} ORDER BY AGENT_ID

SELECT AGENT_ID AS agent_id, WATCHDOG_STATUS AS watchdog_status, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL AS watchdog_interval, THREAD_LLT AS thread_loop_time, TO_CHAR(UPDATE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS update_date, TO_CHAR(NOW(), 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS db_date FROM ${tableName} ORDER BY AGENT_ID
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} ( SEQ, AGENT_ID, WATCHDOG_STATUS, WATCHDOG_INTERVAL, UPDATE_DATE ETC ) VALUES ( nextval('${tableName}_SEQ'), #{agentId}, #{watchdogStatus}, CAST(#{watchdogInterval} AS integer), NOW(), #{monotonicTimestamp} )
